evidence.title: The catalytic mechanism for aerobic formation of methane by bacteria
evidence.boundary: 피루브산 카보닐 탄소의 절단과 달리 인 중심 부가·C–P 절단·고리인산 포획을 결합한다. 반대 방향의 PEP 인산 재배열과도 라디칼 경로·중간체가 다르며 알킬기별로 나누지 않는다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: The ultimate product, PRcP, is formed by nucleophilic attack of the C2 hydroxyl on the covalent thiophosphate intermediate.
evidence.limits: 2013 isotope/EPR and product studies support radical C–P cleavage. Thiophosphate is a proposal supported by 31P NMR; other phosphorus adducts can resonate similarly and MS identification failed. Do not assert every radical relay distance in an unchanging structure.

supplementary.finding: 2023 primary cryo-EM shows ATPase-linked remodelling; the static core places proposed radical centres far apart, so complete catalytic geometry/relay remains unresolved.

evidence.title: Steric Enforcement of cis-Epoxide Formation in the Radical C–O-Coupling Reaction by Which (S)-2-Hydroxypropylphosphonate Epoxidase (HppE) Produces Fosfomycin
evidence.boundary: 알켄에 산화제 산소를 전달하는 에폭시화와 달리 포화 탄소 수소를 제거하고 기존 알코올 산소로 내부 결합을 닫는다. 산소 반동 수산화와도 산소 기원·결합 상대가 다르다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: couples this carbon to the alcohol oxygen on C2
evidence.limits: 2019 primary product/analogue data support radicaloid C–O closure and disfavor the earlier obligatory carbocation pathway. H2O2 is the oxidant. The initiating H-abstractor (ferryl versus caged hydroxyl radical) remains unresolved; row deliberately does not choose one. No variant design, synthesis parameters or potency claims are included.

supplementary.finding: Indexed introduction establishes pre-existing alcohol oxygen and peroxide revision; discussion explicitly leaves initial iron oxidation state unresolved.

evidence.title: Spectroscopic Evidence for the Two C-H-Cleaving Intermediates of Aspergillus nidulans Isopenicillin N Synthase
evidence.boundary: 산소 도입이나 티오알데히드의 가수분해가 아니라 한 산소 분자의 환원을 두 차례의 서로 다른 폐환에 배분한다. 첫 티오카보닐·질소 폐환 뒤 페릴·황 폐환이 이어지는 경로 하나로 묶는다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: they are high-spin Fe(III)-superoxo and high-spin Fe(IV)-oxo complexes, respectively
evidence.limits: 2016 transient kinetics/isotope spectroscopy identify two H-cleaving oxidants. The intervening thioaldehyde/amidation and final C–S coupling sequence is the supported mechanistic model, not direct observation of every state. One linked double-cyclization card, not separate products or heteroatom variants.

supplementary.finding: Scheme 2 text specifies inner-sphere thioalkyl electron transfer, thioaldehyde attack by amide, O–O cleavage/ferryl formation, and final carbon-radical attack on coordinated sulfur.

evidence.title: Mechanism of action of clostridial glycine reductase: isolation and characterization of a covalent acetyl enzyme intermediate
evidence.boundary: 산화 탈아미노화와 반대로 전자를 소비하며 두 탄소를 보존하고 공유 셀레노에터에서 아실 티오에스터로 바꾼다. C1 엽산 전달이나 운반 아미노산의 펩타이드 축합과 다르다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: we have isolated acetyl protein C and shown that it is qualitatively catalytically competent
evidence.limits: 1991 primary acetyl-enzyme isolation and isotope exchange support protein-C thioester and phosphate capture. Formation from Se-carboxymethyl-protein A connects the two covalent carriers. No claim that free ketene rather than alternative direct transfer has been observed.

supplementary.finding: Independent 1991 primary study characterizes protein C participation in reductive cleavage of Se-carboxymethyl-selenoprotein A.

evidence.title: Phosphomethylpyrimidine Synthase (ThiC): Trapping of Five Intermediates Provides Mechanistic Insights on a Complex Radical Cascade Reaction in Thiamin Biosynthesis
evidence.boundary: 개시 라디칼 생성 이후 같은 아데노실종의 위치별 수소 릴레이·당 조각 분리·재결합이라는 경로다. 라이신 공유 고정이나 퓨린 가수분해의 탄소 삽입과 구별하며 비타민 산물별로 나누지 않는다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: five trapped intermediates that provide new constraints on the mechanistic analysis
evidence.limits: 2024 primary isotope and derivatized shunt-product work revises the ThiC cascade. Atom mapping: C1′ becomes formate; C3′ becomes CO; C4′ enters the heterocycle. Hydrogen return to C5′ followed by C4′ abstraction is supported by prior isotope work cited and discussed in this primary paper. Full approximately 20-step pathway remains a model.

supplementary.finding: Chemical Science 2026 volume 17, online 2025-11-18: ENDOR/isotopologues assign an early dihydro-aminoimidazole radical attached to two ribose fragments; mutants trap initial C5′ and C2′ radical species. Does not prove all later steps.

evidence.title: Deciphering the enzymatic mechanism of sugar ring contraction in UDP-apiose biosynthesis
evidence.boundary: 수소 회수만으로 입체중심을 뒤집는 경로와 달리 산화·알돌 개환이 결합해 C–C 골격을 끊고 분지를 재구성한다. 플라빈의 아노머 공유 치환이나 분자 간 알코올 사슬 연장과도 다르다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: decarboxylation occurs only after the sugar ring opening
evidence.limits: 2019 structure, isotope product analyses, mutations and QM/MM support integrated oxidation/retroaldol/reclosure. Bound-NAD reuse alone is not the novelty; coupled C–C opening before decarboxylation and intramolecular branch reconstruction are. Exact microscopic proton paths remain models.

supplementary.finding: 2017 primary isotope work places oxidation and retroaldol opening in a coupled rate-limiting step before irreversible decarboxylation; NADH subsequently reduces the aldehyde product.

evidence.title: Mechanistic Analysis of the Unusual Redox-Elimination Sequence Employed by Thermotoga maritima BglT: A 6-Phospho-β-glucosidase from Glycoside Hydrolase Family 4
evidence.boundary: 양이온성 아노머 치환이나 인산 친핵 공격 대신 NAD 산화가 음이온성 제거를 열고 물 부가 뒤 산화 상태를 회복한다. 같은 NAD 순환의 입체 반전과도 제거되는 결합·중간체가 다르다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: NAD+-mediated redox steps along with alpha,beta-elimination and addition steps via anionic intermediates
evidence.limits: 2006 primary isotope and leaving-group kinetics support C3 oxidation and C2 deprotonation. The glycosidic cleavage follows an anionic elimination/addition route, distinct from oxocarbenium displacement; no separate cards for GH families or alpha/beta substrates.

supplementary.finding: Independent 2007 GlvA isotope/Brønsted study supports the same E1cb/redox pathway and demonstrates that both activated anomers can use it.

evidence.title: Substrate analogs that trap the 2′-phospho-ADP-ribosylated RNA intermediate of the Tpt1 (tRNA 2′-phosphotransferase) reaction pathway
evidence.boundary: 물에 의한 직접 인산 절단이나 영구 ADP리보스 표지가 아니다. 두 단계의 리보실·인산 전달로 기질 인산을 고리인산에 포획하며 시르투인의 아실기 전이·아미드 절단과 반응 중심이 다르다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: the ADP-ribosylated RNA intermediate is virtually undetectable under normal circumstances
evidence.limits: 2020 primary substrate-analogue experiments trap the normally short-lived phospho-ADP-ribosyl RNA species and support the second ribose-O2 cyclizing displacement. Core reaction is chemical phosphate transfer, not an assumed universal endogenous role or clinical effect.

supplementary.finding: 2019 product-mimetic structure supports RNA 2′-phosphate recognition and reaction geometry; does not itself directly capture the native reactive intermediate.

evidence.title: Protein folding in the central cavity of the GroEL–GroES chaperonin complex
evidence.boundary: 기존의 노출 부위 일시 결합을 넘어 덮개 폐쇄·내부 방출·ATP 재개방으로 경계가 있는 공동을 순환한다. 상분리 응축체의 분배와 달리 단백질 벽의 물리적 격리와 주기적 방출이 필요하다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: discharging the unfolded polypeptide into an enclosed cage
evidence.limits: 1996 primary folding experiments establish encapsulated folding and ATP-dependent lid release/retry. Acceleration or completion inside the cage is substrate dependent. Novelty is timed physical encapsulation, surface conversion and release, beyond the current parent's transient exposed-site binding.

supplementary.finding: 1997 primary structure shows apical elevation/twist expands the cavity and hides hydrophobic binding surfaces, leaving a hydrophilic lining.
1998 primary comparison finds an intact central cavity necessary for GroES-dependent substrates; apical minichaperone does not substitute for this folding mode.

exclusions.reason: C6 radical initiation/ring contraction is established, but alternate ring-opening and azacyclopropyl routes remain unresolved. Current boundary from broad radical rearrangement is weaker than accepted candidates; not counted.

exclusions.candidate: UDP-xylose synthase as an additional card
exclusions.reason: Do not split bound-NAD sugar transformations by product alone. UAXS is retained only for coupled retroaldol opening and branch reassembly; simple oxidation/decarboxylation/reduction variant not counted.
Already explicit in glyoxalase-carbonyl-detoxification; no addition.
Already small-ribozyme-two-prime-transesterification. RNA motifs and acid/base identities are not new mechanisms.
Already quinone-q-cycle-vectorial-proton-translocation. Membrane protein or quinone identities do not justify a second card.

exclusions.candidate: KaiC reverse phosphorylation via ATP intermediate
exclusions.reason: Primary paper explicitly identifies reversal of the same autophosphorylation phosphotransfer followed by ATP hydrolysis. Direction/circadian use alone is insufficient for a new pathway card.
Chemical-cue-directed behavior and negative-feedback cover current generic description; methylation implementation alone is not enough without a distinct validated information transformation.
Only the physical lid/cage cycle is proposed; Hsp70 holding, organism-specific chaperonins and proteasome-like ATP threading are not separate additions.
Uses the same first phospho-ADP-ribosylation step with another phosphate position; not separated from the two-step pathway.
